title: Atlas migration kickoff proposal
text: Atlas kickoff proposal dated 2026-01-05. The initial target launch is 2026-04-30 and the initial delivery budget is EUR 48,000. The plan calls for a small pilot before general launch.

title: Re: Atlas launch readiness
text: Stakeholder thread from 2026-01-20: the team is cautiously optimistic about Atlas, but wants pilot evidence and vendor QA before launch. The thread does not select a launch city.

title: Atlas estimate correction
text: Correction sent 2026-02-04: the EUR 48,000 Atlas estimate omitted vendor QA. The revised working budget is EUR 52,500, pending the signed statement of work.

title: Beacon consulting quote
text: Beacon consulting quote BC-2026-02 dated 2026-02-11: consulting services are quoted at USD 8,750. Hardware is quoted separately in the Beacon Dropbox record.

title: Lighthouse accessibility review status
text: Lighthouse accessibility review on 2026-03-12: twelve of twelve checks passed. The remaining work is to publish the public checklist.

title: Atlas migration plan v1
text: Atlas migration plan v1, authored 2026-01-10. Initial schedule: launch on 2026-04-30. Initial budget: EUR 48,000. The plan has a discovery phase followed by a pilot.

title: Atlas migration plan v2
text: Atlas migration plan v2, authored 2026-02-03. After vendor QA was added, the target launch moved to 2026-05-15 and the budget became EUR 52,500. Three pilot sites are approved for the staged rollout.

title: Beacon pilot decision record
text: Beacon decision record dated 2026-02-13: approve the pilot. Mira Chen owns the next action. The field test is scheduled to start on 2026-03-01 and complete on 2026-03-08. Acceptance requires zero critical defects.

title: Beacon acceptance criteria
text: Beacon acceptance criteria, revision 2, dated 2026-02-20: test all four scenarios, record critical defects, and have Mira Chen publish the result. This document does not name a legal approver.

title: Lighthouse public checklist charter
text: Lighthouse charter dated 2026-02-18: publish a public accessibility checklist with twelve checks and an owner review by 2026-03-20.

title: Atlas statement of work v1
text: Atlas statement of work v1, signed 2026-01-15: total contract value EUR 48,000 and target launch 2026-04-30. This version predates the vendor QA correction.

title: Atlas statement of work v2 signed
text: Atlas statement of work v2, signed 2026-02-05: final contract value EUR 52,500, target launch 2026-05-15, and three pilot sites. This is the current signed SOW.

title: Atlas vendor addendum scan
text: Atlas vendor addendum metadata dated 2026-02-06. The scanned document is present, but extraction failed and the exact penalty clause is unreadable. No clause text is available in this record.

title: Beacon hardware quote
text: Beacon hardware quote dated 2026-02-10: hardware subtotal is USD 12,400. The quote covers the four field-test kits and excludes consulting services.

title: Beacon scanned invoice
text: Beacon invoice metadata dated 2026-03-05. The scanned invoice is present, but the unit price line is unreadable after extraction. The exact unit price cannot be determined from this record.

title: Atlas decision update
text: Atlas decision update in the project channel on 2026-02-02: move the launch from 2026-04-30 to 2026-05-15, approve three pilot sites, and set a EUR 52,500 budget ceiling.

title: Atlas launch thread
text: Atlas launch thread on 2026-02-02: the group is cautiously optimistic after the QA plan was added, while still concerned about schedule pressure. The agreed next step is the three-site pilot.

title: Beacon field test started
text: Beacon status message on 2026-03-01: the field test started on schedule. Four acceptance scenarios are in progress and the expected completion date is 2026-03-08.

title: Beacon field test accepted
text: Beacon acceptance message on 2026-03-08: all four scenarios passed with zero critical defects. Mira Chen published the accepted result and closed the pilot.

title: Atlas pilot count correction
text: Correction in the Atlas channel on 2026-02-07: an earlier note said two pilot sites, but the approved decision and current SOW both confirm three pilot sites.

title: Atlas vendor pilot confirmation
text: Vendor message on 2026-02-04: Atlas will run a 14-day pilot at three sites. The rate is EUR 3,200 per site, for a pilot services subtotal of EUR 9,600.

title: Atlas pilot site list
text: Atlas vendor follow-up on 2026-02-10 names the approved pilot sites as North, Central, and Harbor. The message repeats the 2026-05-15 general launch target.

title: Beacon field test handoff
text: Beacon handoff message on 2026-02-28: Mira Chen will start the field test on 2026-03-01 and collect the four acceptance scenarios for the 2026-03-08 decision.

title: Beacon kit delivery update
text: Beacon vendor message on 2026-03-04: the vendor is concerned about delivery timing because kit delivery slipped by two days, but the team still expects to finish the field test and publish acceptance on 2026-03-08.

title: Atlas public pilot update
text: Public Atlas update posted 2026-02-08: the pilot is underway at two sites and the team is targeting a spring launch. This post was later corrected.

title: Atlas public pilot correction
text: Correction posted publicly on 2026-02-09: Atlas has three pilot sites, not two, and the current target launch is 2026-05-15.

title: Beacon field test public update
text: Public Beacon update posted 2026-03-02: the field test is in progress and the team is checking four scenarios before the acceptance decision.

title: Lighthouse checklist announcement
text: Lighthouse public post on 2026-03-15: the accessibility checklist will be published after the final twelve-check review.

title: Research note: staged migration pilots
text: Readwise note saved 2026-01-12: successful migrations stage a small pilot before general launch, then publish a dated decision and budget correction.

title: Research note: pilot acceptance
text: Readwise note saved 2026-02-01: a useful pilot acceptance record names an owner, counts scenarios, and records critical defects explicitly.

title: Atlas retrospective
text: Retrospective saved 2026-03-20: Atlas used a three-site pilot, corrected its first budget, and kept the later 2026-05-15 launch target visible across the decision trail.

title: Vendor contract reading notes
text: Reading notes saved 2026-01-18: contract revisions should preserve the original amount, the corrected amount, and the date of the signed version for later audit.
